method: FYNX Fear & Greed: seven indicators, each scored by its percentile within its own trailing year (inverted where high means fear), averaged.
label: Extreme fear

indicators.name: Market momentum
indicators.desc: S&P 500 versus its 125-day average. Far above it is greed; below it is fear.
indicators.label: Extreme fear

indicators.name: Stock price strength
indicators.desc: S&P 500 members at 52-week highs minus those at 52-week lows, as a share of the index (10-day average).
indicators.label: Extreme fear

indicators.name: Stock price breadth
indicators.desc: Share of S&P 500 members trading above their own 50-day average.
indicators.label: Greed

indicators.name: Market volatility
indicators.desc: VIX versus its 50-day average. A VIX spike above its average is fear.
indicators.label: Extreme fear

indicators.name: Volatility term structure
indicators.desc: VIX divided by the 3-month VIX. Above 1 means traders pay more for near-term protection: stress.
indicators.label: Extreme fear

indicators.name: Safe haven demand
indicators.desc: 20-day return of stocks (SPY) minus Treasuries (IEF). Bonds beating stocks is fear.
indicators.label: Extreme fear

indicators.name: Junk bond demand
indicators.desc: 20-day return of high-yield bonds (HYG) minus investment-grade bonds (LQD). Junk lagging is fear.
indicators.label: Extreme fear

crypto.universe: 37 largest altcoins by market value (CoinGecko, without stablecoins and wrapped or staked tokens) priced against bitcoin on Yahoo Finance

sources.prices: Yahoo Finance daily closes (^GSPC, ^VIX, ^VIX3M, SPY, IEF, HYG, LQD and S&P 500 members)
sources.michigan: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers (tbmics.csv)
